name: Awesome AI Agents
summary: List of AI autonomous agents in two parts, open-source projects and closed-source products, each with features, stack and links.
description: A community-maintained directory of AI agents split into open-source projects and closed-source projects/companies. Entries describe the agent's category, features, stack and links and are kept in alphabetical order; a web UI version adds filtering by category and use case. Scope is AI assistants and agents, while SDKs and frameworks live in a companion list.
contains: two sections: open-source projects, closed-source projects and companies
entries list category, description, features, stack and links
web UI version with filtering by category and use case
contributions via pull request or a form; alphabetical order kept
companion list: Awesome SDKs for AI Agents
